# Migrent

> Migrent is an Australian website for finding a room or a home to rent, built for migrants, international students and new arrivals. Hosts have their government ID checked by a person at Migrent before a room goes live, and every listing is read before it is published. Renters search and apply for free and do not need an Australian rental history. Migrent is not a real estate agent and never holds rent or bond: bonds are lodged with the state or territory bond authority.

## For renters

- [Search rooms](https://migrent.vercel.app/seeker/search): rooms and homes from ID-checked hosts, with the approximate area shown and the street address shared once an inspection is booked.
- [How renting works](https://migrent.vercel.app/how-renting-works): searching, applying with one Rental Profile, inspections, moving in.
- [Suburb guides](https://migrent.vercel.app/suburbs): rent and community figures for every Australian suburb, from the 2021 Census.
- [Rental laws by state](https://migrent.vercel.app/guides/rental-laws): bonds, notice periods and where to get help in each state and territory.
- [How to spot rental scams](https://migrent.vercel.app/blog/spot-rental-scams)

## For hosts and owners

- [Why list with Migrent](https://migrent.vercel.app/for-owners)
- [Pricing](https://migrent.vercel.app/pricing): what Migrent charges, and when.
